svg.title: Computed electron-current streamlines in two side cavities
svg.desc: Same channel width, physical scale, and viscous length in both panels. The smaller cavity contains a closed counterclockwise current circulation; the larger cavity shows predominantly open flow. Teal paths are selected contours of the archived numerical streamfunction. Arrowheads indicate conventional current, opposite to mean electron motion. Pale fill is decorative, not a measured field.
